A link that opens straight to the file beats a login screen every time. Clear “approve” or “request changes” actions. Creative collaboration is everything that happens inside your team before a client ever sees the work. Designers, copywriters, and project managers go back and forth, sharing drafts, leaving internal notes, and aligning on direction.
